{{Quote|You'd need a twisted mind to design a Podracer the way Farwan & Glott did. But you'd need to be totally insane to actually fly one.|Anonymous comment on [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee's]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>}}
'''Farwan & Glott''' was a company that designed [[Podracing/Legends|podracers]], including [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee's]] weird and unorthodox vehicle. It was active as far back as [[3640 BBY]] and had many signs with the company name on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
